From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro demo to cut per-token cost — BrightMind / Redwood

Hey Emily —

Congrats on the recent activity spike — our system flagged BrightMind crossing the 100k token threshold last week. That typically means teams are getting into the meat of production usage and we often help with a short walkthrough to highlight immediate optimizations (batching, prefix cache, and a quick quantization recommendation) that can reduce per-token spend without regressions.

Would you be open to a 20-minute focused session this week? I can run through:
- What the usage snapshot shows (token mix, latency hotspots)
- Quick config levers to try (batch settings, short-term cache rules)
- Next steps and who on your side we should loop in (engineering/ML)

Times I have open (PDT):
- Tue 9/16 10:00–10:20
- Tue 9/16 14:00–14:20
- Wed 9/17 11:30–11:50

Or you can pick any slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood/priyom-20m

Attached is a one-page usage snapshot I pulled to make the conversation faster. CC'ing Ben (AE) so he has context. If you want Marissa (solutions engineer) on the call, we can include her.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
SDR, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai
(Attachment: usage_snapshot_q3.pdf)

—Emily
